root_cause.text: The non-XDR key parsing path in `rxrpc_preparse()` fails to validate the `ticket_length` field against `AFSTOKEN_RK_TIX_MAX`, allowing an unprivileged user to supply an oversized ticket length that later causes a kernel warning in `rxrpc_read()` due to exceeding `AFSTOKEN_LENGTH_MAX`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a validation check `if (v1->ticket_length > AFSTOKEN_RK_TIX_MAX)` in the non-XDR path; the CVE description states the missing validation permits a very large ticket length, leading to a WARN_ON in `rxrpc_read()`.

Author: David Howells <dhowells@redhat.com>

    rxrpc: Fix key quota calculation for multitoken keys
    
    In the rxrpc key preparsing, every token extracted sets the proposed quota
    value, but for multitoken keys, this will overwrite the previous proposed
